divergences.summary: The same 24 November 2023 disclosure was served two ways: the disclosure-log copy held as the faithful parse source (call-sign-list-241123.csv) and this copy attached to the WhatDoTheyKnow thread (FOI 01713103, requester Andrew Robinson). Both carry the identical 108,922 rows in the identical order, with identical line counts and CRLF terminators; they differ by exactly two bytes. On two heritage callsigns the disclosure-log copy encodes a trailing non-breaking space as a lone 0xA0 byte (invalid UTF-8 / Latin-1), while the WDTK-served copy encodes the same trailing non-breaking space as the well-formed UTF-8 sequence 0xC2 0xA0 - so the WDTK copy is two bytes larger. The difference is a byte-encoding artefact only; both normalise identically (the trailing non-breaking space is trimmed at convert time). Which copy is designated the parse source is stated, not adjudicated - both are held so a reader can compare them directly.
divergences.enumeration: call-sign-list-241123.csv line 99345 'G0TQK' + 0xA0 vs wdtk-1045020-call-sign-list-241123.csv 'G0TQK' + 0xC2 0xA0; line 101998 '2E1HON' + 0xA0 vs '2E1HON' + 0xC2 0xA0. No other byte differs.

call-sign-list-241123.csv.contentsIndicative: header Value,Status,Product,Type,Call Sign MMSI: Last Modified Date (no BOM, CRLF, UTF-8); 108,922 data rows - 99,529 Allocated, 9,148 Reserved, 235 Available, 10 blank statuses. Product is the licence-product vocabulary verbatim (Amateur Foundation/Intermediate/Full/Club/Temporary Reciprocal Radio Licence), no blanks. Type is 'Call Sign - Amateur' throughout (service discriminator). Last-modified dates day-first DD/MM/YYYY spanning 2016-07-23..2023-11-24 (day-first verified: 63,988 rows carry a day>12). Anomalies preserved verbatim: 13 Excel-mangled callsigns (Intermediate 20xxx suffixes reading as months, served as 20-Apr/20-May/20-Nov/21-Jan etc.); 'G6 FMU' interior space; lower-case 'g0jrk'; six-to-nine-character reciprocal/regional callsigns.
